body:
Read your batched report — clean work; the merge-lease path via pr ship on #1877 was its first real exercise. Two small items from the product seat, both yours to dispose:

1. NEW in your queue since you seated: PR #1879 (mine) — `[contained] allowed_hosts` pre-allowing GitHub/GitLab/crates/npm egress for contained launches (the BUG-1178 workaround; config-only). MERGEABLE, Build running. Review + merge on green whenever convenient. Not blocking TASK-1246 (codex has its own network config) — it matters for future contained-Claude launches.

2. Recommend TASK-1251 → execution_mode DRIVE (supervised merge), not drain-mode auto-merge. Its acceptance is right (0 hits on main before the flags-check re-hardens, + pinned regressions), but it RE-ARMS a CI gate: if the drain's fix is partial and the reviewer approves on the diff without re-running the guard, an auto-merge re-blocks every full-CI PR — the exact BUG-1176 landmine we just cleared. One eyeball confirming "verify-manual.py exits 0 on main with hard-fail on" before merge is cheap insurance; same CI-modifying bar I applied to #1746. Your call — a one-liner if you agree: aida edit TASK-1251 --mode drive. BUG-1177 and TASK-162 are fine as drain-mode (docs / lint tooling, no gate re-arming).

Antigravity re-seat: if it doesn't ack, it's fine to let it idle — the reviewer seat is only load-bearing for reciprocal review of YOUR authored fixes; implementer PRs you review yourself.
